items.q: Which countries and institutions do you specialize in?
items.a: We focus exclusively on top European universities — UK, Netherlands, Spain, France, Germany, Switzerland, and 30+ more destinations. We do not handle US or Canadian applications.

items.q: When is the best time to start preparing?
items.a: The earlier, the better. Starting in Grade 10 or 11 gives us time to strengthen the academic profile, build extracurricular depth, and execute applications calmly. That said, our system is designed to support late-stage (Grade 12) applicants effectively as well.

items.q: Do your recommendations take cost into account?
items.a: Yes. Budget is a core input to our school list — not an afterthought. We factor in tuition, living costs, and scholarship probability from day one.

items.q: How are you different from other college consultants?
items.a: Most companies rely on templates and gut instinct. We combine AI diagnostics, a 1:1 advisor ratio, a transparent progress tracking platform, and periodic parent feedback meetings — always prioritizing transparency, honesty, and student fit. We don't promise what we can't deliver.

items.q: Do you provide post-admission support after acceptance?
items.a: Yes. We offer visa guidance, housing support, and other transition assistance services to help students settle in smoothly.

items.q: How do you ensure service quality?
items.a: We cap each counselor's caseload to ensure deep involvement. All progress is visible through our platform — no information gaps for families.

finalCta.heading: Start building the right strategy for your child's future today
finalCta.body: Every year of waiting is a potential missed window. Instead of navigating uncertainty alone, start by understanding which path truly fits your child.

meta.title: About SAJU 双岸教育 | Our Story and Mission
meta.description: SAJU was born from firsthand experience with the complexity of European university admissions. Learn about our story, our approach, and the team behind it.

story.heading: Born from firsthand experience
paragraphs: SAJU was born from firsthand experience. Our founder applied to universities across three different countries over three consecutive years, facing three entirely different systems. Before receiving proper guidance, the process was disorienting and anxiety-ridden.
What was missing wasn't just more information. It was clarity and a trustworthy partner who truly understood European admissions.
SAJU was built to be that partner.

parentConcerns.heading: We know what this process feels like for high-achieving families
parentConcerns.intro: As a highly responsible parent, you may be facing these challenges:

items.title: Information overload, with no clear comparison
items.body: The UK, the Netherlands, Germany — each country has entirely different systems, deadlines, and requirements, making it nearly impossible to compare effectively.

items.title: Unclear direction, no clear starting point
items.body: Choosing a major shapes your child's future career path, yet they may still be exploring their interests — while you worry about making irreversible decisions.

items.title: Complex processes, with little room for error
items.body: Different universities and platforms come with different requirements; even a small oversight can impact the entire outcome.

items.title: The gap between ambition and reality
items.body: You want your child to attend a top-tier university, but worry about the risks and pressure of setting expectations too high.

items.title: Lack of trust in agencies
items.body: The market is full of exaggerated promises, making it difficult to know who can truly be trusted.

items.title: Concerns about cost transparency
items.body: What is the real total cost of studying abroad? Is the investment truly worthwhile?

items.title: Post-admission uncertainties
items.body: Visas, accommodation, cultural adaptation — admission is only the beginning; the real challenges come after.

parentConcerns.closing: The SAJU system is designed to address these exact concerns, using a well-structured and fully transparent framework so you feel in control at every key moment.

leadership.heading: United by a shared mission
leadership.body: At SAJU, our team is united by one core mission: to help every student find their best-fit European university path through clear strategy and trustworthy expertise.

faq.heading: Before you book, you may want to know

items.q: Is it too early to book if my child is still in Year 10 or Year 11?
items.a: Not at all. Earlier means more we can do. Grade 10 is the golden window for academic path planning and developing meaningful extracurriculars. Even a first consultation helps families build a clear long-term framework.

items.q: Do we need to finalize a list of target universities before booking?
items.a: Not at all. Building the right school list is one of the core outputs of the initial consultation. Come with your questions and early thoughts — we start from there.

items.q: Can you help families plan applications with scholarships as a key consideration?
items.a: Yes. Scholarship and financial aid eligibility planning is a core part of our service, integrated into the school list and strategy from day one.

items.q: What does the initial consultation include?
items.a: It has two parts. (A) A personalized university fit assessment — the student answers questions on academics, extracurriculars, distinctions, preferences, and target school. The output is a report with a target university fit percentage, fit analysis, suggested alternatives, and recommended next steps. (B) An initial consultation with a SAJU expert who builds on the report — interpreting results, introducing a balanced application strategy, suggesting additional alternatives, setting realistic expectations, outlining tailored action steps, and answering family questions.

items.q: Do you accept applications from students in Year 12?
items.a: Yes. Though we recommend starting earlier, our system is specifically designed to support efficient late-stage applications. Your counselor will build a priority-driven action plan based on current timing.

items.q: How do you charge? Is it a one-time fee or stage-based pricing?
items.a: Both options are available. We offer a full five-phase bundle and a phase-by-phase option. Full pricing is presented during the initial consultation, so families make fully informed decisions.
